title: 12 spots left to a two-week Trading Challenge with a $2,500 prize pool
author: Fynca
selftext:
Thanks to the Reddit users who compete the first challenge.

A simulated trading tournament. Each trader gets demo capital. After 11 days, the traders with the highest returns win a $2,500 cash prize pool.  
No real money is traded, just your research, strategy, and execution. I'm also doing 1-on-1 demo meetings to explain the system or discuss any considerations.

Starting from 31.08 until 10.09

Ask me anything.
